About our brand and products:

Nelson Naturals offers eco-friendly, zero-waste oral care made in Nelson, BC Canada. Our toothpaste, tablets, and accessories come in reusable glass jars and use premium, natural ingredients like hydroxyapatite.

What makes us different:

We eliminate plastic tubes with glass packaging, focus on science-backed formulas, and are committed to real results for people and the planet.

How affiliates can earn:

Earn 12% commission on every sale made through your unique link or code. There are regular promotions and no earning limits.

How to promote us:

Share your experience on social media, blogs, or email. Show off our products, talk about our hydroxyapatite toothpaste, and use your link or code in your content.

Welcome to the Nelson Naturals Inc. Affiliate Program. By participating, you agree to follow the rules and guidelines below. Violations may result in commission forfeiture, account suspension, or removal from the program.

 

 

PERMITTED PROMOTIONAL METHODS

 

We love creative promotion! You are welcome to share your affiliate link or coupon code through:

 

- Your personal website, blog, or product review content

- Organic (non-paid) social media posts on your personal accounts

- Email newsletters sent to your own permission-based subscriber list

- YouTube videos, podcasts, or other organic content

- Private communities such as Facebook Groups, Discord servers, or group chats where you are an established member

- In-person recommendations and direct referrals

 

If you'd like to promote Nelson Naturals in a way not listed above, please reach out to us first for approval.


 

PAID ADVERTISING — STRICTLY PROHIBITED

 

Affiliates are NOT permitted to run any form of paid advertising to promote Nelson Naturals Inc. This includes:

 

- Google Ads (Search, Shopping, Display, or Remarketing)

- Microsoft/Bing Ads or any other pay-per-click (PPC) platform

- Paid social media ads on Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, or any other platform

- Sponsored placements on coupon, cashback, or deal aggregator websites

 

This prohibition applies regardless of the keywords or targeting used.

 

BRAND BIDDING IS PROHIBITED

 

You may not bid on "Nelson Naturals" or any variation of our brand name (e.g., "Nelson Naturals coupon", "Nelson Naturals discount", "Nelson Naturals toothpaste") on any paid search or advertising platform.

 

DIRECT LINKING VIA PAID ADS IS PROHIBITED

 

You may not use your affiliate link or a redirect/cloaked URL as the destination of any paid advertisement. All paid traffic must not be directed to nelsonsnaturals.com through an affiliate link under any circumstance.

 

Why this rule exists: Brand bidding means we pay affiliate commission on customers who were already searching for us and would have found us for free. It also competes with our own advertising efforts and inflates costs for everyone. It also compromises our brand marketing integrity and regulations. 

 

COMMISSION & PAYMENT INTEGRITY

 

Commissions are only paid on valid sales that comply with these rules. Nelson Naturals Inc. reserves the right to withhold or reverse commissions on any orders found to have resulted from prohibited promotional activity, including paid search advertising.

 

---

 

DISCLOSURE REQUIREMENTS

 

You must clearly disclose your affiliate relationship with Nelson Naturals Inc. wherever you share your affiliate link or coupon code. This is required by law (FTC guidelines) and by our program. A simple statement such as "This post contains affiliate links — I may earn a commission if you purchase through my link" is sufficient.

 

VIOLATIONS & ENFORCEMENT

 

Nelson Naturals Inc. monitors affiliate traffic sources and promotional activity. If we determine that these rules have been violated:

 

- Pending and unpaid commissions may be forfeited

- Your affiliate account may be suspended or permanently terminated

- We may seek reimbursement for commissions already paid on prohibited traffic

 

QUESTIONS?

 

If you're unsure whether a promotional method is allowed, please contact us before proceeding. We're happy to work with you and want to see you succeed as a Nelson Naturals affiliate.

 

Contact: hello@nelsonnaturals.com

Website: nelsonsnaturals.com
